name: a-module-declaring-more-memory-than-the-host-admits-is-refused
note: The ceiling is host configuration and both answers are conforming — a daemon bounds nothing (DAEMON §4), a leaf bounds one page (LEAF §4.2) — so the scenario supplies the number rather than reading it off whichever host is running. It is the one host limit no instance descriptor publishes, because a module past it never instantiates and has no descriptor to read (§9.7 rule 10). The refusal is the loader's on every host and therefore names both numbers.
